summary: DeviceCheck is Apple's server-backed per-device bits (DCDevice tokens) and App Attest (DCAppAttestService), which depend on Apple's attestation servers and Apple hardware keys. BifrOSt has no counterpart and no planned equivalent in the repo; the account service in bifrost-cloud is not device attestation.

features.apple: DCDevice, two per-device bits stored on Apple servers
features.note: Needs Apple's device-state server; no BifrOSt counterpart
Attestation key is generated in Apple hardware and verified by Apple; Linux has no equivalent
Server verifies Apple-signed objects; not applicable to BifrOSt

gaps: Nothing to match: the service is Apple-hardware and Apple-server bound (App Attest needs Apple's attestation service and device keys)
